required_checks.completion: State the bounded transformation or arrangement represented by Constraint Geometry.
Provide a recoverable bounded output demonstrating declared metric or dynamic behavior under all guardrails.
Confirm the term is process-bound and non-substrate, with no external physical claim.
Retain C1/L0 unless the bounded output independently supports elevation.
Record configuration, inputs, outputs, and hashes for the bounded check.

falsification_condition: Failure of any guardrail, absent recoverable output, or drift toward substrate-level interpretation keeps the term at L0.
